# FDG7022

> AVOID question marks and exclamation points in exception messages.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.2.1 Error Message Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG7022
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Message: Remove the question mark or exclamation point from the exception message

Test profile: none, as for FDG7021. FDG7022 reports a question mark or an exclamation point in a string literal, or in the text parts of an interpolated string, passed to a parameter named message of the constructor of a type derived from System.Exception. The operators != and ?? and the ?. and ?[ of a quoted expression are not counted. Messages built at run time are not checked, so coverage is partial. There is no code fix.
